**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 79 **Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225) **Prerequisites** [Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); your animal shape grants a claw unarmed attack **Requirements** You’re in hybrid or animal shape. --- Sinking your claws in, you propel yourself at shocking speed. You [Climb](/Actions.aspx?ID=2374) up to your land Speed and make a claw Strike at any point during that movement. After you finish the movement, attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check against the surface's Climb DC. **Success** You maintain your position.
**Failure** You slide down 60 feet or to the ground without taking falling damage.
